constraints.description: Release matrix covers profiles, clients, sources/keys/tenants, history/deletes, SLOs, ASO budgets and authorization lifetimes.

validation.validation_method: accepted contract checklist and independent review

constraints.description: Every retained named dependency has exact local identity plus API, compatibility and current maintenance/security evidence; unsupported choices have revised owners.

validation.validation_method: locked metadata, Context7, official sources and local audit scans

constraints.description: JSON artifacts are valid and touched files do not exceed 500 lines.
Assess/Plan provenance findings receive a fresh independent review.
The research makes no unsupported production-readiness or vulnerability-waiver claim.

global_rules: Current source and lockfiles outrank historical receipts.
Testing is local only; c003 contains no product behavior change.
Blocked dependency audits remain blockers and are not converted into passing evidence.
termination_conditions: The receipt identifies source drift and every later remediation owner.
